**Finding submitted — deviation (AUDIT), fallback target.**

- **Responsive clause:** § 3.4 (p0022) is the sole audit/inspection right binding us; searches for audit, inspection, verification, records and premises access returned nothing else, and no HDI right of access to our systems exists.
- **Already at or above fallback:** 30 days' prior written notice (vs. 15-day floor), inspection during our normal business hours, and HDI bearing its own inspection costs unconditionally (better than the 10% underpayment trigger — so we did not import that exception, which would only weaken us).
- **Material gap:** no frequency limit, i.e. unlimited-frequency inspections.
- **Cure:** one surgical insertion of ", no more than once per year," into the existing sentence, preserving every other word verbatim. Preferred-level refinements (independent auditor, off-site, express no-system-access) were not pursued: the right is a records inspection by HDI's General Manager and would require collateral rewrites.
